Export.Routine:
kill ^IHC.Cern3MCodeAssistResults WRITE !, "Exists: " _$DATA(^$GLOBAL("^IHC.Cern3MCodeAssistResults")) WRITE !, "Creating globals!"
WRITE !, "Creating global HddTargetConfigName using default: HddInterfaceWebserviceOperation." set ^IHC.Cern3MCodeAssistResults("HddTargetConfigName") = "HddInterfaceWebserviceOperation"
WRITE !, "Creating global PV1ThreeLocationContext using default: 526065969 for defualt iCentra PV1-3 location values." set ^IHC.Cern3MCodeAssistResults("PV1ThreeLocationContext") = "526065969"
WRITE !, "Creating global GenericNcidContext using default: 2000 which is the 3M Context!" set ^IHC.Cern3MCodeAssistResults("GenericNcidContext") = "2000"
WRITE !, "Creating global CernerContextForNcidToRep using default: 526003992 which is the iCentra to Intermountain 50035 Context!" set ^IHC.Cern3MCodeAssistResults("CernerContextForNcidToRep") = "526003992"
WRITE !, "Creating global PV1TwentyAllowed using default: 14604085 Medicare and 526030877 Medicare Advantage!" set ^IHC.Cern3MCodeAssistResults("PV1TwentyAllowed") = $LB(14604085,526030877)
WRITE !, "Exists: " _$DATA(^$GLOBAL("^IHC.Cern3MCodeAssistResults")) WRITE !, "Done Creating Global!" ZWRITE ^IHC.Cern3MCodeAssistResults
